ddl.name: chk_audit_logs_actor
ddl.value:
("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'system' AND "audit_logs"."actor_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("audit_logs"."actor_type" <> 'system' AND "audit_logs"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: check_personal_curricula_age_range
ddl.value: "personal_curricula"."age_min" IS NULL OR "personal_curricula"."age_max" IS NULL OR "personal_curricula"."age_min" <= "personal_curricula"."age_max"

ddl.name: check_play_sessions_identity
ddl.value: "play_sessions"."child_profile_id" IS NOT NULL OR "play_sessions"."guest_device_id" IS NOT NULL
